title: Multi-Scale 2D Temporal Adjacency Networks for Moment Localization With Natural Language
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: There are several related tasks, such as temporal action localization [1]–[5], anomaly detection [6], video summarization [7], [8], and moment localization with natural language [9]–[13].

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: To guarantee a ﬁne-grained localization of action instances, especially for precise temporal boundaries, we further build up multi-scale 2D temporal maps, in which multiple choices of time unit are considered.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Moreover, the multiscale maps can be regarded as a sparse sampling with different intervals on a dense single-scale temporal map, thus reducing the computation costs of moment feature extraction and temporal context modeling.
